summary: Namespaces must follow the dot notation rule based on the first explicit argument. Several declarations take an existing Mathlib type as their first explicit argument but are placed in the root EpsilonEridani namespace, while the main file incorrectly nests the upstream type Real as EpsilonEridani.Real when the declarations take ℕ first. Additionally, lemmas proving an Iff must carry the _iff suffix.
